answer: Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. Splitting into 4 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded terrace account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The inlet explorer shows the whole merge tree. That is 37 dollars per alias.
